verdict.rationale: Datalab documents its own first-party CLI with concrete commands (`datalab convert ... --format html`, `--mode accurate`), and a probe confirms the official CLI docs page exists, so the story's core is delivered directly. The documentation shows the CLI only for conversion, and nothing independent confirms how it behaves in agent workflows. Missing for 10: no independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI use, no evidenced CLI coverage beyond conversion (e.g., extract, segment, pipelines), and no documented agent-oriented features such as machine-readable output modes or non-interactive auth.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: Use the Datalab CLI to convert documents from the command line.
